project: Dungeon Quest — Cheat Catalog Implementation Audit
status_notes: The v31 Options -> Debug HUD route was confirmed by the user to open.
That confirms the screen route, not the effect or persistence of each individual native debug action.
All 222 user-designed catalog entries are currently marked requires_game_adapter in the source design.
Three entries have partial candidate matches to existing debug controls; these are not implemented adapter connections and must remain unverified until on-device state/read-back/rollback tests pass.
No paid entitlement, receipt or purchase-validation mutation is included in this catalog.
